chunks: When the messengers came to the family of Lot,
ai.seo_question: Who arrived at the house of Lot in this Quranic verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the transition from the general mission of the angels to the specific test of hospitality and purity within Lot's household, emphasizing the contrast between the righteous host and the corrupt populace. The arrival serves as the catalyst for the divine judgment, illustrating how the 'messengers' (mursalun) act as harbingers of both warning and destruction. This moment underscores the theological theme of divine justice intervening when moral decay reaches its zenith.
